docs.title: Automated Documentation Demo
docs.text:
Welcome to the Automated Documentation Demo.

This project demonstrates how documentation can be automatically generated and published using:

  • GitHub Actions
  • Doxygen
  • MkDocs
  • GitHub Pages

docs.title: Project Overview
docs.text:
This project contains a simple Python calculator with documented functions for:

  • Addition
  • Subtraction
  • Multiplication
  • Division

The source code contains documentation comments that are processed by Doxygen to generate technical documentation.

MkDocs is used to create a user-friendly documentation website.

docs.title: Usage
docs.text: The Automated Documentation Demo contains a simple Python calculator with four basic arithmetic operations.

docs.title: Importing the Calculator
docs.text:
The functions can be imported from the calculator module:

from src.calculator import add, subtract, multiply, divide

docs.title: Addition
docs.text:
The add() function adds two numbers.

result = add(10, 5)
print(result)

Output:

15

docs.title: Syntax
docs.text:
add(a, b)
  • a — First number
  • b — Second number
  • Returns the sum of the two numbers

docs.title: Subtraction
docs.text:
The subtract() function subtracts the second number from the first.

result = subtract(10, 5)
print(result)

Output:

5

docs.title: Syntax
docs.text:
subtract(a, b)
  • a — First number
  • b — Second number
  • Returns the difference between the two numbers

docs.title: Multiplication
docs.text:
The multiply() function multiplies two numbers.

result = multiply(10, 5)
print(result)

Output:

50

docs.title: Syntax
docs.text:
multiply(a, b)
  • a — First number
  • b — Second number
  • Returns the product of the two numbers

docs.title: Division
docs.text:
The divide() function divides the first number by the second.

result = divide(10, 5)
print(result)

Output:

2.0

docs.title: Syntax
docs.text:
divide(a, b)
  • a — Numerator
  • b — Denominator
  • Returns the division result as a float

docs.title: Division by Zero
docs.text:
The function prevents division by zero.

result = divide(10, 0)

This raises:

ValueError: Cannot divide by zero.

docs.title: Example Program
docs.text:
The following example uses all four operations:

from src.calculator import add, subtract, multiply, divide

a = 20
b = 5

print("Addition:", add(a, b))
print("Subtraction:", subtract(a, b))
print("Multiplication:", multiply(a, b))
print("Division:", divide(a, b))

Output:

Addition: 25
Subtraction: 15
Multiplication: 100
Division: 4.0
